available_primary_implementations.role: ISO reference software; inspect LD conditional branches before using as oracle.
Pinned Fraunhofer fixed-point STP implementation. Inspected energy scale switch implements TREE_212; it does not by itself qualify all multichannel trees.

stp_reference_findings: ISO subbandTP uses static energy and previous-scale history shared between decoder instances.
ISO LD output weighting loop reaches BP[n+3-10] for n=3..6, producing negative indices.
ISO tree 7 leaves i_LFE uninitialized, then reads it in the unconditional channel exclusion at line 343.
Pinned FDK stores STP history in STP_DEC per handle; its hybrid buffer offset and crossover must be translated explicitly before comparison with LD QMF bins.
implementation_boundary_at_initial_resea: Active STP remains refused. Do not silently patch the ISO oracle and claim unmodified-reference equivalence; resolve LD indexing and verify synthesis/navigation using owned synthetic media first.
subsequent_resolution: The low wet interval0..11 is zeroed before final mixing. The owned STP stage skips unused invalid reads and retains the defined active-bin formula exactly. The adapted ISO probe initializes absent tree7 indices and evaluates only populated tree5/6 energy groups; every adaptation is explicit. See aac-ld-mps-stp-reference-2026-10-30.json and aac-ld-mps-stp-tests-2026-10-30.json. This does not provide independent normative Annex B verification.
